# report_coding_session_usage_tool

> Report the token usage of a coding-agent CLI session you ran (Claude Code, Gemini, or Codex) so its cost is tracked under your user.

| | |
|---|---|
| Category | `developer`, `silolink` |
| Callable | MCP clients; grantable to agents |
| Filter | `https://www.dsiloed.com/api/v1/mcp?tools=report_coding_session_usage_tool` |

## Description

This is the description the server sends to the model, verbatim.

Report the token usage of a coding-agent CLI session you ran (Claude Code,
Gemini, or Codex) so its cost is tracked under your user.

Call this at the END of a coding session, before you close it. Provide the
per-model token counts the session used. The usage is priced server-side
with the same model catalog used for everything else and shows up in your
Cost dashboard, attributed to you.

For accurate, automatic tracking, prefer the `silo-link report-usage` CLI
wired into a Stop hook — it parses the local transcript and posts exact
numbers without you having to supply them. Use this tool for manual or
agent-driven reporting.

Idempotent: re-reporting the same cli_session_id overwrites that session's
running per-model totals rather than double-counting.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `tenant_id` | string | yes | Tenant ID or enterprise identifier the usage belongs to. |
| `cli_type` | string | yes | Which coding-agent CLI produced this usage: claude (Claude Code), gemini, or codex. One of: `claude`, `gemini`, `codex`. |
| `cost_basis` | string | no | "real" when the session billed a metered API key (BYOK), "imputed" when it ran on a subscription/OAuth (no per-token charge). Defaults to "imputed". One of: `real`, `imputed`. |
| `cli_session_id` | string | no | The CLI's own session id. Used to dedupe repeated reports of the same session — always pass it so re-reports overwrite rather than duplicate. |
| `session_name` | string | no | Optional human label for this session (e.g. "refactor auth module"). |
| `usage` | array of object | yes | Per-model token summaries for the session. One entry per model used. |
